            "signature": "create_page_with_next_number(uuid,text,text,text,text,jsonb)",
            "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_page_with_next_number(p_book_id uuid, p_image_path text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'processing'::text, p_ocr_text text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_ocr_confidence text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_lesson jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)\n RETURNS pages\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\r\ndeclare\r\n  v_page public.pages;\r\n  v_next_page_number integer;\r\nbegin\r\n  if auth.uid() is null then\r\n    raise exception 'Authentication required';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  perform 1\r\n    from public.books\r\n    where id = p_book_id\r\n      and user_id = auth.uid()\r\n    for update;\r\n  if not found then\r\n    raise exception 'Book not found or not accessible';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  select coalesce(max(page_number), 0) + 1\r\n    into v_next_page_number\r\n    from public.pages\r\n    where book_id = p_book_id;\r\n\r\n  insert into public.pages (book_id, page_number, image_path, status, ocr_text, ocr_confidence, lesson)\r\n  values (p_book_id, v_next_page_number, p_image_path, p_status, p_ocr_text, p_ocr_confidence, p_lesson)\r\n  returning * into v_page;\r\n\r\n  return v_page;\r\nend;\r\n$function$\n",
